stress.ja:
ストレスがかかると、焦りから衝動的に動いたり、新しい刺激を追って気を紛らわせようとしがちです。
落ち着くには、立ち止まって優先順位を整理し、一度リスクを点検するのが効果的です。
stress.en: Under stress you tend to act on impulse from restlessness and to chase new stimulation as a distraction. To settle, pause and re-order your priorities and run one risk check.

learning.ja: 体系的な理解と深掘りで学ぶのが得意。概念の背景や理屈を自分の頭で整理しながら腹落ちさせていきます。じっくり時間をかけて理解を深める学びが向いています。
learning.en: Learns through procedures and practice — laying out steps and repeating them by hand until they stick. Excels where the goal and the process are clear.

work.ja: 独自のビジョンを、自分のペースで形にする仕事で力を発揮します。構想を深め、独立して追求する場に向いています。干渉の多い環境は苦手です。
work.en: Excels where you shape an independent vision at your own pace — deepening a plan and pursuing it alone. Heavily-directed environments sit less well.

relationships.ja: 自分の軸を保ち、冷静に適度な距離で人と関わります。合理的で誠実ですが、ときに距離を置きすぎて孤立しがちな面も。

ja: 時には立ち止まり、リスクを点検する習慣をもつ

Practice trying things as you go, before over-thinking.
Consciously cross-check your inner world against outer reality.
Sometimes step a little closer and try empathy and cooperation.

It infers psychological and cognitive characteristics from your answers and builds the profile by reference to related neuroscience research. features_long.en: Strong interest in, and approach tendency toward, the new, an approach that moves things forward with analysis and planning, one that draws energy from engaging with the outer world, and a style that highly empathetic and in tune with others' feelings — this combination forms a distinctive cognitive profile.

落ち着くには、立ち止まって優先順位を整理し、一度リスクを点検するのが効果的です。
stress.en: Under stress you tend to act on impulse from restlessness and to chase new stimulation as a distraction. To settle, pause and re-order your priorities and run one risk check.

learning.ja: 手順と演習を通じて学ぶのが得意。段取りを立て、実際に繰り返し手を動かして身につけます。目的と手順が明確な学びで力を発揮します。
learning.en: Learns through procedures and practice — laying out steps and repeating them by hand until they stick. Excels where the goal and the process are clear.

work.ja: 新しい企画の立ち上げや、人を巻き込む挑戦で力を発揮します。チームをまとめながら新しい領域を切り拓く場に向いています。一方、単調なルーチンワークは苦手です。
work.en: Excels when launching something new and getting people on board — rallying a team to carve out a fresh territory. Monotonous routine work is a poor fit.

relationships.ja: 相手の気持ちを自然と感じ取り、温かく関わります。情緒的なつながりを大切にし、人の力になりたいと願います。ただ、感情を受け止めすぎて疲れやすい面も。

ja: 時には立ち止まり、リスクを点検する習慣をもつ

Hold your own feelings and boundaries too, not just empathy.

features_long.ja: リスクや不確実さを察知して備えやすいことと、情報を整理し、段取りを立ててから動くこと、自分の内面・想像・思索を大切にすること、他者と情緒的につながることを好むことが合わさった、特徴的な認知スタイルです。
features_long.en: Strongly cautious and vigilant, an approach that moves things forward with analysis and planning, one that directs energy toward an inner world, and a style that highly empathetic and in tune with others' feelings — this combination forms a distinctive cognitive profile.

heads off major failures through caution
skilled at organising information and thinking in a structured way
delivers steady results through planning and reliability
deep thought and imagination let them build a world of their own
a clear view of themselves and insight from reflection

eases the mood of a team and draws out its strengths

stress.ja:

learning.ja: 体系的な理解と深掘りで学ぶのが得意。概念の背景や理屈を自分の頭で整理しながら腹落ちさせていきます。じっくり時間をかけて理解を深める学びが向いています。

Consciously cross-check your inner world against outer reality.
Hold your own feelings and boundaries too, not just empathy.

stress.ja:
ストレスがかかると、警戒が強まり、不安や心配が先に立って動けなくなりがちです。
落ち着くには、最悪を想定しすぎず、小さく一歩を試して安心を積み重ねるのが効果的です。
stress.en: Under stress your vigilance rises and anxiety or worry can get in the way of moving. To settle, avoid assuming the worst — take one small step and rebuild a sense of safety.

learning.ja: 実践と試行を通じて学ぶのが得意。実際に手を動かし、現場で失敗しながら体得していきます。教科書的な座学より、やってみて身につけるスタイルが合っています。
learning.en: Learns through experience and trying things — touching and failing on the spot until it settles in. Suits a do-it-then-understand style rather than sitting in lectures or reading textbooks.

work.ja: チームを支え、リスクを管理する仕事で力を発揮します。慎重さと共感で、周囲を安心させる場に向いています。無謀な挑戦を迫られる環境は苦手です。
work.en: Excels where you support a team and manage risk — reassuring those around you with caution and empathy. Settings that push reckless gambles sit less well.

relationships.ja: 相手の気持ちを自然と感じ取り、温かく関わります。情緒的なつながりを大切にし、人の力になりたいと願います。ただ、感情を受け止めすぎて疲れやすい面も。
relationships.en: Naturally picks up on others' feelings and relates warmly. Values emotional connection and wants to help; the flip side is that absorbing too much emotion can leave them tired.

ja: 小さく試して、安心を積み重ねる一歩を増やす

en: Add small test steps to build a sense of safety.
After a gut call, take a moment to check the evidence.
Carve out regular time away from people and stimulation to reflect.
Hold your own feelings and boundaries too, not just empathy.

scientific_background.en: Your answers fit a cognitive profile that is cautious and vigilant; this is studied in relation to the Vigilance & Threat-Processing System (includes the amygdala). Judging through intuition and in-the-moment feeling has been linked to the Salience / Interoceptive System, and drawing energy from the outer world to the Social Cognition Network.

scientific_note.ja:

scientific_note.en: This check does not perform brain measurement (fMRI, EEG, etc.).
